items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know that Freddie Waits was the drummer I chose, because he was playing on my band.

ctx.x: A certain personality? What was your criteria?

I mean musical personality, a certain musical personality for them, something unique about them. I remember when Freddie brought his own conga player to play on one track. Rudy – he had Rudy turn off the machine until the guy left. That’s how particular they were about players. Yeah, he was very particular. But it’s okay, because his choices were agreeable to me. I know that Freddie Waits was the drummer I chose, because he was playing on my band. Bob James played in the band too, Bob James along with Ron Carter.…
